A.name: Botanical Pixel Specimen
A.blurb: A field-guide plant in crisp, restrained pixels: recognisable leaves, roots, flower and seed clock; every trait alters real anatomy.

B.name: Field-Journal Cutaway
B.blurb: An inked journal plate: a specimen box with a deep soil cutaway, so the roots read as clearly as the leaves; changes travel through it.

C.name: Strange Alien Herbarium
C.blurb: A real organism from an unknown world: an asymmetric, curling body plan with bolder trait changes — strange, never magic.

D.name: Organic Hybrid
D.blurb: Friendly and readable like A / B with a little of C's weirdness: chunky shapes, a curl of personality, bold silhouette changes.
